_doc: MCTS constants that ship WITH v10c0.bin. Same consumption contract as v9c0.constants.json: foul-play (config.py, search_server.py) and valuenet/sprt/run_duels.py:_sidecar_constants copy every PE_* key here into the engine environment when --nn-weights / PE_NN_WEIGHTS points at the matching .bin; explicit PE_* already in the environment wins.

_measurement.what: EMPIRICAL c-response curve (48,384 games, 2026-08-20) + lnN transfer to ladder budget. The sigma_R ratio transfer that set v8/v9 is RETIRED -- see valuenet/sigma_tune.py.

response_curve_at_12k_iters.protocol: v10c0 (A) vs v9c0 (B), DUEL_ITERS=12000, MIRROR=1, PE_PHANTOM_MODE=off, paired on identical teams + chance seeds
response_curve_at_12k_iters.below_0.019: COLLAPSE. c=0.005 is -51.5 Elo vs c=0.0345 (z=-3.50, p=0.0005, survives Bonferroni); c=0.010 is -38.0 Elo (p=0.0099).
response_curve_at_12k_iters.0.019_to_0.042: FLAT PLATEAU. All 10 pairwise paired comparisons n.s.; largest |d| 4.7 Elo at p=0.57.
response_curve_at_12k_iters.above_0.042: mild decline: 0.0515 -> +2.4, 0.0650 -> -6.5, vs 0.0422 -> +16.9 (earlier 250ms sweep, less controlled).

_measurement.why_0.02: The plateau above was measured at 12,000 iterations. The ladder searches 4500ms, ~10x more, and the explore/exploit ratio is k = sqrt(c*lnN)/sigma -- the n cancels but lnN does not. lnN goes 9.39 -> ~11.81, ratio 1.258, so c=X on the LADDER behaves like c=1.258X did in the test. The measured plateau [0.019, 0.042] therefore maps to a ladder-equivalent plateau of about [0.015, 0.033]. c=0.02 sits inside it (equivalent to 0.0252 at 12k); c=0.0345 would sit just ABOVE its top (equivalent to 0.0434 at 12k), in the region where decline was measured. Sally's call, 2026-08-20.
_measurement.caveats: (1) The lnN transfer assumes optimal k is N-invariant. That is the same FORM of assumption that broke the sigma transfer, though better founded -- lnN is structurally in the bonus formula, whereas the sigma^2 scaling was an interpretation of what sigma_R means. (2) Ladder runs PHANTOM_MODE=cut with ALPHA=0 / SELF_AS_SEEN=0.2, and phantom_mult multiplies exploration (mcts.rs:764), so phantom arms get zero or reduced bonus. That suppression is selective, not global, so it does not cleanly offset (1). (3) No c value has ever been measured AT ladder settings; that run remains the open item. My analysis favoured 0.025 as robust under both readings; 0.02 is the chosen value.
